title: An internal work order has no Bill To field
custom_preconds:
BLOCKED ON RELEASE: this test checks Bill To on internal and No Charge work orders, which needs Internal Work Orders (SV-11665), not released yet. Do not run it now. It can be tested once SV-11665 is released.

Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer I, an internal customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer I, in Estimate, that bills itself.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer I as an internal work order.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card shows Authorizer.
  • No "Bill To" field shows.
